scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter cms build
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U spectra -d spectra
scripts.db:restore: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U spectra -d spectra -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /backup/spectra-db.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait postgres
